description: Describes the 5 number-skill screening games on dyscalculia.io (21 items in total): for each game its key, name, the skill it measures, the task, item count and how items and games are scored in general terms, plus the fixed item order, the not-a-diagnosis statement, the limits (no norm sample, percentiles or accuracy study) and the methodology link. Use this to explain what the test is and how it works; use get_prevalence or list_chart_data instead for research figures about dyscalculia. It is a description only: it takes no answers, scores no one and returns no result, and the test is a screening of basic number skills, not a diagnosis. An unknown game key returns an error listing the valid keys.

game.description: Return only this game (exact key): dotEnumeration, symbolicCompare, nonSymbolicCompare, numberLine, digitSpan. Omit for all 5 games, in the order listed here.

include_items.description: When true, adds each returned game's item set (dot counts, number pairs, number-line targets, digit-sequence lengths). Default false. Works with or without game.

name: explain_screening_test
title: Explain the free number-skills screening test
